segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func collectionView(_ collectionView: UICollectionView, contextMenuConfigurationForItemsAt indexPaths: [IndexPath], point: CGPoint) -> UIContextMenuConfiguration? { return UIContextMenuConfiguration(actionProvider: { suggestedActions in if indexPaths.count == 0 { // Construct an empty-space menu. return UIMenu(children: [ UIAction(title: "New Folder") { _ in /* Implement the action. */ } ]) } else if indexPaths.count == 1 { // Construct a single-item menu. return UIMenu(children: [ UIAction(title: "Copy") { _ in /* Implement the action. */ }, UIAction(title: "Delete", attributes: .destructive) { _ in /* Implement the action. */ } ]) } else { // Construct a multiple-item menu. return UIMenu(children: [ UIAction(title: "New Folder With Selection") { _ in /* Implement the action. */ } ]) } }) } ```
